posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: Why is it that most of the ziploc bags used by >G when packaging Sentinels cards (eg the dividers in an expansion box, or the mini-expansions) have a small round hole through both sides of the bag?  I'm reluctant to use these bags to store my HP and status tokens, for fear that the latter especially will poke out through the hole, work it wider, and eventually cause the bag to spill its contents.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I use bags for all my tokens, including my homemade start/end of turn ones which have quite sharp corners due to them having been cut with a scalpel rather than die cut (I am planning to clip the corners like wargamers do but haven't got to it yet).

And all my bags have holes for the reason Ronway explained. In fact, most of my games are bagged up like this and even with very cheap bags I haven't had a problem. If a hole does ever widen you'll notice it way before it's big enough for a token to fall out.
